  • Constructor Details

    • StructureType

      protected StructureType(String key, int version, List<MovementDirection> validMovementDirections, List<Property<?>> supportedProperties, String localizationKey)
      Constructs a new StructureType. Don't forget to also register it in StructureTypeManager.
      Parameters:
      key - The key that uniquely identifies this StructureType. E.g.: "windmill" or "bigdoor".
      version - The version of this StructureType.

      This is used for serialization purposes. If you change the structure in a way that makes it incompatible with the previous version, you should increase this number. This will allow you to handle the transition between the old and new version.

      validMovementDirections - The valid movement directions for this structure.
      supportedProperties - The properties that are supported by this type.
      localizationKey - The key that is used to localize the name of this StructureType. For example, "structure.type.revolving_door".

    • getValidMovementDirections

      public Set<MovementDirection> getValidMovementDirections()
      Gets a set of all theoretically valid MovementDirection for this given type. It does NOT take the physical aspects of the Structure into consideration. Therefore, the actual set of valid MovementDirections is most likely going to be a subset of those returned by this method.
      Returns:
      A set of all valid MovementDirection for this given type.
